name: lorebridge
description: A secure AI bridge for tabletop RPG campaign tools and knowledge.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@lorebridge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@lorebridge/foundry-module && npm run build --workspace=@lorebridge/backend
scripts.build:foundry: npm run build --workspace=@lorebridge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@lorebridge/foundry-module
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@lorebridge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run verify:foundry
